# Affidavit of Service and Case Filing Summary
Filing Package for US District Court, Northern District of Illinois

## Action Details
| Case Caption | Case Number | Assigned Judge | Summons Issued |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Apex Logistics LLC v. Crestline Freight Inc. | 1:26-cv-04182 | Hon. Evelyn Ramirez | 03/12/2026 |

## Service Record
- Process server: Marcus Vance (Illinois Licensed Detective #115-002194)
- Recipient: Crestline Freight Inc., through registered agent Thomas Sterling
- Address: 1420 Enterprise Way, Suite 300, Schaumburg, IL 60173
- Date and time of service: 03/18/2026 at 10:45 AM
- Documents served: Summons, Complaint, and Local Rule 3.2 Corporate Disclosure Statement

## Notarization Details
State of Illinois, County of Cook.
Subscribed and sworn to before me on 03/19/2026 by Marcus Vance.

Notary public commission expires on 01/14/2025.
Notary Public Signature: Clara Higgins

## Filing and Calendar Summary
Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 12(a)(1)(A)(i), a defendant must serve an answer within 21 days after being served with the summons and complaint.

- Electronic filing docket entry: Document 6 (Affidavit of Service)
- Defendant Crestline Freight Inc. was served on 03/18/2026.
- Responsive pleading deadline calculated as 04/15/2026.
- Discovery planning conference deadline under FRCP 26(f) pending responsive pleading.

errors.explanation: The notary certificate indicates that the notary's commission expired on 01/14/2025, but the jurat was executed on 03/19/2026. A notary cannot perform official notarial acts with an expired commission.
With service effected on 03/18/2026, 21 days pursuant to FRCP 12(a)(1)(A)(i) results in a response deadline of 04/08/2026, not 04/15/2026.
